''See also: [[The Eternal Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Eternal is the vessel commanded by [[Cheska Bennett]], the Blackwatch Guild Head{{!}}Guild Head of the Navigators. An Awakened ship, it is constructed from a single, seamless piece of wood that features a burnt reddish-orange hue. The ship is distinguished by its bright red sails and hull, which are decorated with alchemical paint in a matching shade. A notable characteristic of the vessel is its ability to appear as though it is drifting upon a tide of flame, trailing fire across the [[water]]'s surface when traveling at high speeds. Despite its striking and spectacular appearance, the ship suffered a catastrophic failure when it was torn in half by an explosion, resulting in significant wreckage and survivors being rescued by the crew of [[The Testament]].}}

== Of Sea and Shadow ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-01-of-sea-and-shadow|The Eternal is an approaching Awakened ship characterized by its blazing red sails and a wake of fire. This vessel features a main room and was observed waiting a day's trip away from the [[Gray Island]]. During its travels, a single Guard was noted to remain within the ship while paddling.}}

== Of Dawn and Darkness ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|The Eternal is a seaworthy vessel that previously served as the site for a meeting between [[Guild Heads]]. While approaching its current location to the port of [[Calder]], the ship faced [[destruction]] when it was ripped to shreds. Although it would sink if dropped by the [[Lyathatan]], the vessel is expected to return to the [[water]].}}
